description:
Inspect XBRL mapping overrides for a statement identity

Return an override trace showing which mapping rules were evaluated, applied, or suppressed for one filing's statement, named by cik, statement_type, fiscal_year, fiscal_period and the filing's accession_id. The filing's current statement is read. An accession that serves no statement for the identity answers 404 EDGAR_STATEMENT_NOT_FOUND with details.available_accessions.

accession_id.description: SEC accession of the filing whose statement to trace, as returned by /v1/edgar/companies/{cik}/statements. The filing's current statement is read.

canonical_metric_code.description: Optional canonical metric code filter (e.g., REVENUE, NET_INCOME).

cik.description: Company CIK as digits (for example 0000320193), or a ticker symbol (for example AAPL). A ticker resolves to the company whose filings hold its statements as of the request's as-of or period-end date, or as of today when the request has none.

dimension_key.description: Optional dimension key filter (e.g., segment slice).

fiscal_period.description: Fiscal period code (e.g., FY, Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4).

fiscal_year.description: Fiscal year for the statement identity (>= 1).

statement_date.description: End date of the statement's period (YYYY-MM-DD). Needed only when the filing reports more than one statement for the fiscal year and period: a fiscal year split at a business combination or fresh-start reorganization is reported as two OTHER periods. Without it such a request answers 409 `EDGAR_STATEMENT_AMBIGUOUS`, listing the dates in `details.available_statement_dates`.

name: edgar_companies_statements_overrides_trace
